title: Count Repeated Words
statement:
You are given a text, already split on spaces into `n` words. Count how many times each word repeats in the text.

A word **repeats** if it appears at least twice. Words are compared exactly as given (they contain only lowercase letters).

Print every repeating word together with the number of times it appears, one per line, in the order in which each word **first appears** in the text. Words that appear only once are not printed. If no word repeats, print `NONE`.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
The following tokens (separated by spaces or newlines) are the `n` words of the text.
outputFormat: For each repeating word, in order of first appearance, print a line `word count`. If no word repeats, print `NONE`.
constraints: Each word has between 1 and 10 lowercase English letters

examples.input:
9
the cat and the dog and the bird fly
examples.explanation: `the` appears 3 times and `and` appears 2 times. `the` is printed first because it appears first in the text. `cat`, `dog`, `bird` and `fly` appear once and are skipped.
Every word appears exactly once, so no word repeats.

tests.input:
10
x x x x x x x x x x

8
a c b b ab a b a

8
b a cc ca b ac b bb

hints: You need a way to remember how many times each word has been seen so far. Which data structure maps a word to a count in O(1)?
Count all words in one pass. Then walk through the text again in order to print each repeating word only once.
